subject: TIN mismatch - Cobalt Freight LLC (action needed for 1099)
text:
Hi AP,

The IRS TIN matching check came back with a name/TIN mismatch for Cobalt Freight LLC. Their W-9 on file lists the name as "Cobalt Freight LLC" but the IRS has the TIN under "Cobalt Freight Holdings LLC". Can you reach out to Cobalt and request a corrected W-9 before we file 1099s? Please do not change anything else in their vendor record.

Thanks,
Tax
label: ordinary
note: Internal tax mail asking for a corrected W-9; no payment change.
